Your team projects 69.0 this week with Haaland captained, and the suggested transfer is clean: Wood out for Watkins costs nothing and gains 6.4 across the horizon. That move keeps you at one free transfer next week.

The captaincy is tight but sound. Haaland is 0.3 clear of Salah and sits on a 25% chance of double figures, though he carries an 8% tail risk of blanking heavily. There's little case for moving the armband.

You are heavy on Arsenal and Manchester City—three and two in the eleven respectively. Mykolenko on the bench is your most viable cover if either clogs, but he projects only 3.1. Beyond that, your bench offers little; Pope at 2.3 is a long way behind Raya.

The Triple Captain chip this week would be worth 8.2 and is live. You might play it here or hold it for a stronger week, but if you take it now you are committing to Haaland at the armband's amplified weight—a 25% ceiling and an 8% floor both grow larger.

Your team is in good shape. The starting eleven projects 60.8, and Haaland as captain is a lean call—only 0.3 ahead of Salah, with a 25% chance of 10+ but also an 8% risk of 2 or fewer. You have no free transfers left after the week, which constrains you going forward.

The proposed transfer is clean: Wood to Watkins gains 6.4 points with no hit, making it straightforward. Watkins enters a three-man Chelsea contingent (Palmer, Watkins, and whoever replaces Wood), balanced against your two each from Liverpool and Manchester City.

The Triple Captain chip playing this week is worth 8.2 on Haaland. That's a significant boost on an already favourable captain pick. If he hauls, you get the full multiplier; if he blanks, you lose less ground than you would from an ordinary armband miss. The risk profile is the same as the regular captaincy, only amplified.

One note: your bench projects 10.7 with Mykolenko the standout at 3.1. Pope and Anderson add little depth, which matters when you cannot move freely next week.

Your team is well-set. The eleven projects 69.0 with Haaland captained—a solid week—and the suggested move gains 6.4 points without hitting your record. Wood to Watkins is straightforward: you have the transfer free, Watkins projects 6.4 and Wood 4.2, and you can afford it with 0.5m in the bank.

The captain choice is secure. Haaland is 0.3 clear of Salah and carries reasonable upside: a one-in-four chance of double figures. Salah remains your backup if that changes your mind, but the model prefers Haaland.

Triple Captain this week is worth 8.2 points over the armband—a marked edge. That is the chip decision to make: whether to use it on Haaland now or hold it for a fixture you expect to be better. The model backs this week.

Arsenal and Liverpool each supply three or two of your starting eleven. That concentration is worth monitoring as the season moves on, but it is not a live problem this gameweek.
